vision.name: Vegito
vision.text:
(Your Drills are not discarded when advancing or lowering from this level.)
[Continuous]: Your energy attacks deal +1 life card.
[Instant] POWER: Use when one of your effects requires you to discard 1 card from your hand during combat. Draw a card and raise your anger 1.
POWER: [Attack] 2: Energy attack.
Search your Life Deck for a Drill and place it into play.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: Search your discard pile for 3 Styled cards and Rejuvenate them.
vision.note: edge reads HERO -> MP; Trait badges S, E, F; stage cost printed as '2:'; F badge confirmed as Fusion by the T_Fusion trait card
